services.desc: A great beach trip gets even better when you are not trying to squeeze all your time on the water into one afternoon. Whether you are planning family outings, fishing runs, sandbar stops, or relaxed sightseeing along the coast, having a boat for several days gives you room to enjoy it all at your own pace. Our family-owned team makes it easy to plan memorable time on the water with quality rentals, friendly service, and flexible options for vacationers staying in the area.
